notes: Where the nonogram pictures come from, and the licence evidence that lets them ship at all.
The pictures are the silhouettes of the game-icons.net repository, read from its archive by
build.mjs; `archive` is written by `build.mjs --update-sources` from the bytes it actually read,
and every other run refuses an archive whose SHA-256 differs from the one recorded here.
The licence sentence is quoted verbatim from the archive's own license.txt, and build.mjs refuses
to build when it is not there. That file says the icons are CC BY 3.0 or CC0 'if mentioned below':
the contributors marked CC0 there (Viscious Speed, Zeromancer) are left out, and so is every folder
with no named contributor (badges, various-artists) or whose folder name is not the author's (lucasms).
`fetchedAt` is the date the archive was read for the hash recorded here.
